selection: The epoch (or C for eGeMAPS) is chosen by balanced accuracy on validation speakers from the training corpus, so neutral and distress count equally. The calibration temperature and the decision threshold are fitted on the same validation speakers; test_* fields are raw (threshold 0.5), the calibrated block uses them. Confidence intervals resample whole test speakers (1000 rounds). Test speakers are scored once. Distress F1 is also shown, next to the F1 of a classifier that always predicts the larger class.
iemocap: IEMOCAP is not in this study. The files require a signed license from USC SAIL and were not downloaded. The third rotation, training on IEMOCAP plus one corpus and testing on the other, is the planned extension once that license is in hand.

text.finding: RAVDESS contributes 2 fixed sentences, and 2 of them are spoken as both neutral and distress. CREMA-D contributes 12 fixed sentences, and 12 of them are spoken as both neutral and distress. The words do not carry the emotion label, so no text branch was trained on these transcripts. At use time the assistant reads the words separately and the judge combines that reading with the voice score.

disagreement.note: The Monitor audio weights are not saved, so the disagreement check was skipped.
